claims.disposition: verified_existing; contradiction preserved. first_word_after (L89-96) per-chunk trims non-alnum (except _) then find(!empty) returns the FIRST finite alphanumeric word; allowlist membership is the sole gate (fail-closed). claims.summary: Test 2 (integration): pass a string with a marker followed by a 'non-relational verb (e.g. marker is a tool)' to scan_known_model_control_markers and assert the marker is stripped/handled per the reference_syntax rules.
claims.disposition: verified_existing; contradiction preserved (non-domesticating).
